newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two tremors shake central, southern Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Two tremors shake central, southern Mexico.

text.p: Two tremors rattled Mexico on Thursday, officials said, but no damage or injuries were reported.
A quake measuring 4.9 on the open-ended Richter scale hit the coast between the southwestern states of Oaxaca and Guerrero at 8:51 a.m. (1351 GMT), the National Earthquake Service said.
The other tremor, measuring 3.5 on the Richter scale, hit the central states of Puebla and Morelos at 1:37 a.m. (0637 GMT).
